properties.name: Kraken Krits & Fumbles C&C
properties.author: The Kraken
properties.description: Critical hits and fumbles for Castles & Crusades (official CnCRPG and SiegeCore) by the Castle Keeper's Guide's own optional rules (Chapter 17, Options 1, 4, 5 and 6; the CK picks one). On a natural 20 or natural 1 the table is rolled and the result applied: conditions and penalties as tracker effects, extra and self damage as damage rolls, maximum or doubled damage on the next damage roll; instant death and maiming are announced for the CK. Built into SiegeCore.
